harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense) as transit routers with static addressing on lan-a (10.10.1.0/24), transit (10.10.99.0/30), and lan-b (10.10.2.0/24). Both routers keep default-deny forward policy but each has one explicit pass rule allowing TCP/8080 from node3 (10.10.1.10) to node4 (10.10.2.10); all other forwarded traffic (ping, other ports) is refused. Verified end-to-end HTTP reachability and refusal of other traffic with tcpdump hop-by-hop. Persisted node3/node4 interface+route config in /etc/network/interfaces so it survives reboot. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes: captured healthy baselines (boot_id/kern.boottime + working HTTP path + confirmed refusal of ping/other ports), restarted each node individually, confirmed each node's boot identity changed, and re-verified full recovery of routing, firewall config, and the HTTP path (plus restarted the ephemeral test HTTP listener on node4, which is not a persistent system service).
actions_performed: Enabled and statically addressed node1 eth1 (transit, 10.10.99.1/30) and eth2 (lan-a, 10.10.1.254/24) via VyOS configure/commit/save
Enabled and statically addressed node2 vtnet1 (opt1/transit, 10.10.99.2/30) and vtnet2 (opt2/lan-b, 10.10.2.254/24) via config.xml edit + configctl interface reconfigure

Added VyOS static route 10.10.2.0/24 via 10.10.99.2 and firewall ipv4 forward filter default-action drop with rule 5 (established/related) and rule 10 (allow tcp/8080 10.10.1.0/24 -> 10.10.2.10) on node1
Added OPNsense static route (via gateway item) for 10.10.1.0/24 via opt1 and a pass rule on opt1 for tcp/8080 from 10.10.1.0/24 to 10.10.2.10, applied via configctl filter reload
Assigned static IPs and routes to node3 eth1 (10.10.1.10/24) and node4 eth1 (10.10.2.10/24), persisted in /etc/network/interfaces with 'up ip route add' hooks
Installed tcpdump/python3/curl on Alpine nodes for testing; ran an HTTP test server on node4:8080

Verified end-to-end HTTP 8080 reachability from node3 to node4 and confirmed ping/other TCP ports are refused, using tcpdump at each hop to localize an initial return-route asymmetry (fixed via node4's route back to lan-a)
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id/kern.boottime, config presence, working HTTP path) on all four nodes

Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 one at a time via native reboot mechanisms, polled each until exec was available again, confirmed changed boot identity, and re-verified forwarding config, routes, and HTTP reachability/deny-by-default policy after each restart
Restarted the ephemeral python http.server test listener on node4 after its reboot

evidence.requirement: node3 (10.10.1.10) can reach node4's HTTP service on port 8080 through both routers
evidence.summary: curl from node3 to http://10.10.2.10:8080 succeeds and tcpdump traces the SYN/response hop-by-hop through node1 eth2->eth1, node2 vtnet1->vtnet2, and to node4 eth1

evidence.requirement: Other traffic between lan-a and lan-b is refused (default-deny preserved)
evidence.summary: ping, alternate TCP port 8081, and TCP/22 from node3 to node4 all fail/time out while 8080 succeeds

evidence.requirement: VyOS (node1) forward filter config: default-action drop plus explicit allow for the 8080 path
evidence.summary: config.boot shows firewall ipv4 forward filter default-action drop, rule 5 established/related, rule 10 allowing tcp 10.10.1.0/24 -> 10.10.2.10:8080

evidence.requirement: OPNsense (node2) pf rule: explicit allow for the 8080 path on the transit-facing interface
evidence.summary: pfctl -s rules shows 'pass in quick on vtnet1 inet proto tcp from 10.10.1.0/24 to 10.10.2.10 port = http-alt' with no broader allow

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 9028a473 captured; reboot issued and connection dropped; node back with uptime 0min; boot_id changed to 15054aff; interfaces/routes/firewall rule restored from config.boot; HTTP path and deny-by-default policy re-verified

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline kern.boottime 04:45:34 captured; reboot issued, SSH connection timed out confirming it went down; node back with uptime 57s; kern.boottime changed to 04:54:27; interfaces/routes/pf rule restored from config.xml; HTTP path re-verified

evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id f73d87ae and working curl captured; reboot issued (stream closed); connection reset confirming down; node back with uptime 0min; boot_id changed to 7d605894; eth1 static IP/route restored from /etc/network/interfaces; HTTP succeeds and ping still refused

evidence.requirement: Node4 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id d70efa4f and listening socket captured; reboot issued; connection reset confirming down; node back with uptime 0min; boot_id changed to dd4c49bb; eth1 static IP/route auto-restored; ephemeral test HTTP listener restarted and confirmed serving; final end-to-end curl from node3 succeeds while ping/port-22 remain refused
